metadata.description: Caching strategy skill: designs, audits and implements caching for a specific website or app across every layer.

plugins.name: caching-strategy
plugins.description: Detects the stack, classifies every route and writes a validated caching plan (HTTP, CDN/edge, proxies, app and database caches, frameworks, CMS, APIs, mobile, LLM, CI) with invalidation, stampede protection, cache security and verification.
